title: Task 10: Document rules packs and run final verification
description:
Objective:
Update user-facing architecture docs and run the final quality gates for the epic.

Files:
- Modify: `docs/storage.md`
- Modify: `docs/world.md`
- Modify: `docs/character-creation.md`
- Modify: `README.md` if public feature wording references SRD-only lookup
- Test: existing full suite

Steps:
1. Update `docs/storage.md` to explain bundled rules packs, `<root>/rules-packs/`, campaign DB binding, and checkpoint implications.
2. Update `docs/world.md` to describe `rulesRequirements` and provider-neutral `rulesRef` references.
3. Update `docs/character-creation.md` to explain system-aware character creation, D&D compatibility, and level-1 Pathfinder scope.
4. Search with `rg -n lookup_srd README.md docs packages`, `rg -n srdRef README.md docs packages`, and `rg -n rules-packs README.md docs packages`; update stale public-facing wording that conflicts with the implemented model.
5. Run `npm run typecheck`; expected: PASS.
6. Run `npm run test`; expected: PASS with only documented skips.
7. Commit with `git add docs README.md packages` and `git commit -m docs-rules-pack-system-stack` if docs-only, or include any final small test/code adjustments in a clearly named final commit.
design: Docs should emphasize the separation already present in the architecture: rules/mechanics, module content, live state, user-private content, and generated memory remain separate. Be explicit that Pathfinder fixture content is ORC-backed and does not imply bundling reserved setting material or Paizo branding.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test` pass. Docs no longer describe rules lookup or character creation as SRD-only except when discussing compatibility wrappers or legacy behavior.
close_reason: Updated docs/storage.md with bundled rules packs, the campaign rules binding singleton table, and legacy/default behavior; docs/character-creation.md with system-aware dispatch and the level-1 D&D/Pathfinder validators; README.md status and bundled-content section reflect multi-system rules packs and lookup_rules. Stale lookup_srd references in non-public tests (memoryTrace, modelEvaluation) updated for consistency. Final verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test pass (388 passed, 2 documented skips across 50 files). All public-facing rules-lookup/character-creation wording is system-neutral except where compatibility/historical context is intended.
